items.title: Spring Boot vs Quarkus on a 512 MB VPS with JDK 25
items.blurb: I ran equivalent Spring Boot 3.5 and Quarkus 3.39 applications side by side on the same 512 MB VPS. Both were JVM applications running on JDK 25 . Quarkus native image was not used.
